[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Mistran''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He commanded the stormtrooper detachment aboard the [[Curich-class shuttle|''Curich''-class shuttle]] [[Resurgence (Curich-class)|''Resurgence'']]. Dedicated to the Empire, Mistran was arrogant but smart. He belittled anyone who was not a part of his stormtrooper unit, and was eager to attain glory.<ref name="Godking" />
